svg.title: Quillfin Video: from upload to screen
svg.desc:
Quillfin Video: from upload to screen What runs today, what is being built, and what comes next States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Planned, Retiring. Solid lines: data flows today. Dotted lines: connection to build. Rollout: 1. Encode on GPUs (Processing); 2. One record for each video (Video record); 3. Recommendations (Recommendations).
Blocks, left to right: - Where videos come from (Four ways in): Creator app; Web uploader; Partner API; Live streams (in trial). Owner: Creator team - Processing [step 1]: Upload checks; Transcoding; GPU encoding (being built); Auto captions (planned). Owner: Media team - Video record [step 2, being built] (Everything known about each video): map: Channel publishes Video; Video encoded as Rendition; Video has Caption; Video watched in View; Caption written in Language. example 'Example: video 7Q4M': Length 12 min 40 s; Renditions 1080p, 720p, 480p; Captions English, Spanish; Status Ready to play. Owner: Media team - Storage: Files: Original files; Renditions. Records: Metadata database; Search index (in trial); Cold archive (planned). Owner: Platform team - Recommendations [step 3, planned]: Watch history; Ranking model. Owner: Not yet named - Player apps: Web; Phones; TV (being built). Owner: Apps team - Service health: Playback errors; Start-up time; Old dashboards (retiring). Owner: Reliability team Groups: - Media pipeline (Run by the media team): Processing, Video record Lines: - Where videos come from -> Processing - Processing -> Video record - Video record -> Storage - Video record -> Recommendations (connection to build) - Storage -> Player apps - Storage -> Service health, labeled "logs" - Recommendations -> Player apps (connection to build) - Where videos come from -> Player apps, labeled "Live streams skip processing" - Where videos come from -> Service health, labeled "Upload failures go straight to service health" Note: Example. Quillfin Video is an invented company. Every system, owner and status is made up.
